what: a second labeller on the same ten blind conversations: another Opus agent run by the owner (2026-10-31), its answers rebuilt from the owner's pasted comparison (16 points differ from the owner, 23 agree; options and traps alike)
reading: The two Opus readers agree with each other (0.89) far more than either agrees with the owner (0.66 and 0.69): the judge is consistent, and the gap is a different standard for 'understood' (the owner credits the gist; both models want it shown). The gate's reference is the owner, fixed before the run, so the verdict stays fail; two models of one family can share a bias, so their agreement does not make them right.
verdict_unchanged: fail (judge_owner_agreement 0.66 < 0.70; 0.68 even with the owner's two possible misclicks fixed)
